history.summary: The $833 PSF looks like a steal versus the $1,299 median, but that is a size illusion: 2,400 sqft for a '3BR' is a penthouse/maisonette-class unit, and the cheap PSF reflects the large floor area, not value. Freehold near Paya Lebar is a plus, but the $2M quantum for an oversized, niche unit plus a 6-txn appreciation read makes this a thin, hard-to-exit investment.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $833 vs $1,299 median screams cheap, but 2,400 sqft is roughly double a normal 3BR — large units always carry a PSF discount, so the headline gap is not real value. The inflated score_1000 of 874 is driven by this PSF illusion. Appreciation +4.45%/yr rests on just 6 URA txns (unreliable). At $2M for a niche, oversized freehold unit, the buyer pool is shallow and exit is slow despite the Paya Lebar location.
red_flags: 2,400 sqft 'oversized unit' — large-format PSF discount masquerading as value
Appreciation rate from only 6 URA txns — statistically meaningless
Niche big-quantum format ($2M) — shallow buyer pool, slow exit
Older 2006 freehold boutique block — likely small development, thin liquidity
catalysts: Freehold tenure near Paya Lebar Central / airbase relocation corridor
Generous space appeals to a multi-gen family own-stay niche (not investment)

history.summary: The headline 'cheapness' is a jumbo-unit size discount and illiquidity artifact, not a true bargain; boutique 40-unit FH with weak exit.
history.rating_rationale: The $833 psf looks dramatically cheap (age_adj -47.4%, psf_premium -31.7%) but it is for a 2,400 sqft unit, flagged oversized_unit + bedroom_sqft_mismatch. Verified recent transactions ran ~$1,299 psf (947 sqft, Mar 2026); jumbo units structurally trade far below project PSF, so almost all of the discount is the size effect, not a forward edge. The supporting data is thin — appreciation_txns = 6 and psf_cohort_txns = 0 — exactly the data-quirk profile the priors warn against. It is a 40-unit boutique freehold: very few comparable trades and a $2M / 2,400 sqft unit has a tiny buyer pool, so exit liquidity over 5-7yr is poor. Freehold is not itself a forward edge. Net: not an Avoid (real FH asset near Paya Lebar, holds value), but not a value bargain either.
red_flags: oversized_unit + bedroom_sqft_mismatch: 2,400 sqft drives the low PSF, not value
appreciation_txns = 6 and psf_cohort_txns = 0: data too thin to trust the discount
40-unit boutique = poor liquidity; large jumbo unit very hard to exit
catalysts: Freehold tenure (value preservation, but not a forward return driver)
~8 min walk to Paya Lebar MRT interchange
